project_type: Flask web app with AI chat feature (Gemini/Groq backend)
build_system: pip install from requirements.txt, deployed via Dockerfile/nixpacks on Railway
verification_instructions: 1. Install deps with pip. 2. Run python -c 'import app' to verify no syntax errors. 3. Manually confirm system prompt, output filter, CSS and JS changes.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages from PyPI or run docker builds. Use AST validation (python -c import) for verification.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Changes are direct to app.py, makima-ai.css, makima-ai.js.
key_patterns: System instruction is in _MAKIMA_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION variable (line 28). Gemini model is initialized with system_instruction param. Groq uses OpenAI-style messages with system role. AI responses returned as jsonify({'reply': reply}). JS uses textContent for rendering (no markdown parsing). CSS uses mobile breakpoint at 768px.
directory_structure: Root: app.py (Flask), static/css/ (stylesheets), static/js/ (client JS), templates/ (Jinja2 HTML)
